messages:
maya: Planning to run the customers.addresses schema change + backfill this Thu 02:00 UTC. Targeting a 30m dual-write window. Need owner for deploy + rollback readiness.
jonathan: I can lead the deploy. Will be available for the window. Can we split into: pre-create index (concurrent) -> feature flag rollout -> dual-write -> backfill? :point_up:
maya: yes that's the plan. Index create should be done before the window if possible. Backfill is the long step.
sasha: FYI the backfill touches ~1.2M rows, estimate ~18-22 min on staging hardware. I'll run a scaled run tonight to confirm. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
michael: I'll do the pre-index migration during Tue maintenance window (concurrent index). Will post results.
jonathan: For rollback: we keep feature flag and dual-write off. Rollback steps: 1) stop new writes to normalized_address (flip flag), 2) route reads to old column, 3) revert DB schema if needed. Anyone want a short runbook snippet?
sasha: please add the smoke checks: 1) write/read sample user via api, 2) sampling on consumer queues for errors, 3) small join query latency check (<200ms).
maya: exact smoke SQLs would help. jonathan, can you add the commands you'll run?
jonathan: putting quick SQLs here:
```
-- smoke write
INSERT INTO customers.addresses (customer_id, normalized_address) VALUES (12345, 'TEST');
-- read
SELECT normalized_address FROM customers.addresses WHERE customer_id=12345;
-- quick join latency check (limit 100)
SELECT a.customer_id FROM customers.addresses a JOIN customers c ON a.customer_id=c.id LIMIT 100;
```
jonathan: Also will monitor replica lag and connections during the dual-write. infra-oncall, can you be reachable for DB signals?
infra-oncall: I'll be on call for that window and will monitor PG stats, replica lag, and CPU. Set me as @infra-oncall in the schedule.
maya: thanks. sasha, can you confirm the scaled run time by EOD today? If <25m we keep 30m window, else bump to 45m.
sasha: running now, will post results in this thread. :mag: 
deploy-bot: Deployment window tentative: 2025-11-06 02:00 UTC -> 02:45 UTC (requested by maya). Please confirm owners.
michael: confirmed pre-index Tue, i'll post logs.
jonathan: confirmed deploy owner and rollback lead. I'll also open a short PR for the feature flag toggles and post checklist.
maya: perfect. tagging checklist items for final runbook: pre-index done, canary traffic 10%, smoke checks pass, rollback flag ready, infra-oncall present. If all green we proceed. :white_check_mark:
